# extract test fixtures

- `xlswithmacro.xlsm` — a benign Excel workbook (.xlsm / OOXML) containing VBA
  macro modules. Used to prove the OOXML → vbaProject.bin → MS-OVBA decompress
  path yields cleartext macro source.

  Source: [Velocidex/oleparse](https://github.com/Velocidex/oleparse)
  `test_data/xlswithmacro.xlsm` (MIT License, © 2014 John William Davison).
  Vendored unchanged for offline testing.

- `fixture-encrypted.rar` — an encrypted-headers (-hp) RAR 5 archive with two
  small plaintext text members, generated by the stock Debian `rar` package.
  Public test data only: fixed password, no real secrets.

  - Members: `note.txt` (43 bytes, "hello from mailstrix encrypted rar fixture\n"),
    `readme.txt` (36 bytes, "second plaintext member for listing\n").
  - Password (public): `fixture-password`.
  - Writer: rar 2:7.11-1 ("RAR 7.11 Copyright (c) 1993-2025 Alexander Roshal
    20 Mar 2025", Debian trixie non-free), inside a throwaway container.
  - Container base image digest: `debian@sha256:9cc080028c43b27d2074d63a5f9caf7166d731494965616c1a6d2827a004585c`.
  - Generation date: 2026-09-19. File sha256:
    `6ad488fd109874aa604eefb7ecb6ff187fa92fdfc8359814d0c628696bb24f14`.
  - Exact generation command (run inside the container):
    `rar a -hpfixture-password fixture-encrypted.rar note.txt readme.txt`
    (`-ma4` / RAR4 creation is unavailable in rar 7.11 and newer; encrypted
    RAR5 is both written and decrypted correctly by the pinned
    github.com/nwaples/rardecode/v2 v2.2.5).
  - Reader layout observed by rardecode v2.2.5: `note.txt` is the first file
    member with `Encrypted=true, HeaderEncrypted=true`; a wrong password is
    rejected by `NewReader` ("rardecode: incorrect password").

- `fixture-encrypted-files.rar` — RAR5 with encrypted file bodies and
  visible archive flags. Copied unchanged from
  [SharpCompress](https://github.com/adamhathcock/sharpcompress/blob/2cba09eba4ae400756933807ee5b0aae56bd4fa7/tests/TestArchives/Archives/Rar5.encrypted_filesOnly.rar).
  Its test uses the public password `test`. The three distinct file members
  observed with rardecode v2.2.5 are:

  - `exe/test.exe`: 45,056 bytes; SHA-256
    `8557928804f57ecc340b3bb38b095a3607474ec8deb0076f316fcfe02b562106`.
  - `jpg/test.jpg`: 40,372 bytes; SHA-256
    `b251c7501fb0f55dd4a92feabe0a6f5733bc40a02679498155fae9b30138fc53`.
  - `тест.txt`: 15,498 bytes; SHA-256
    `4d581d93d369f6e1c9b295ff38d82dabd577f927dfaf0c35818c015c85e322d9`.

  Archive SHA-256:
  `e5fb06af812633b246430f029a051cc462d00180a0df455a798644deccdc7d07`.

  in `archivepw_test.go` (see that file for member layout and passwords), not
  written by any installable 7z tool.
